title: How Sink Drainage Works: Understanding Traps and Vents
description: Every functional sink drainage system relies on gravity, a properly installed trap, and an adequate venting network to function safely and efficiently. The P-trap holds a standing plug of water that acts as a vital barrier, preventing sewer gases and unpleasant odors from entering the living space. Meanwhile, the sanitary tee and vent connection ensure air can freely enter and escape the system, maintaining neutral pressure so water flows smoothly without siphoning the trap dry. Learning the mechanics of sink drainage empowers you to diagnose gurgling sounds, slow flow, and trap siphoning with confidence.

Meanwhile, the sanitary tee and vent connection ensure air can freely enter and escape the system, maintaining neutral pressure so water flows smoothly without siphoning the trap dry. Learning the mechanics of sink drainage empowers you to diagnose gurgling sounds, slow flow, and trap siphoning with confidence.
